# GPU environment — the one that produced every model result in this repository
# =============================================================================
# Steps 80-96 (trunk caching, head training, probes, design gates) ran here.
# Steps 01-71 and 97-99 do NOT need a GPU; see env/local-analysis.lock.txt.
#
# HONESTY NOTE, READ THIS BEFORE TRUSTING THE PINS BELOW.
# `scripts/80_setup_pod.sh` installs with `pip -q install`, which suppresses the
# resolution output, so no `pip freeze` was ever captured and the rented hosts
# were destroyed after each run. The versions below are the ones EVIDENCED by
# the surviving run logs and by the pinned installer; the full transitive set
# was never recorded and is NOT reconstructed here, because inventing pins would
# be worse than admitting the gap.
#
# To produce a real, fully-resolved lockfile: run scripts/80_setup_pod.sh on a
# fresh instance and immediately `pip freeze > requirements.resolved.txt`.

# ---- evidenced directly by a saved log ----
# output/ois_gates/logs/setup.log and ois_enhancer_run/logs/setup.log both print:
#   "grelu 1.1.0 | torch 2.8.0+cu128 | cuda True"
gReLU==1.1.0
torch==2.8.0+cu128          # CUDA 12.8 wheel, installed as the base image's system torch

# ---- evidenced by the installer script (scripts/80_setup_pod.sh) ----
# genomepy + pyfaidx arrive as gReLU dependencies; the script calls both directly.
genomepy                    # version not pinned by the installer, not captured
pyfaidx                     # version not pinned by the installer, not captured

# ---- observed at runtime on the host, not preserved in a log file ----
# python 3.12.3              (`python3 -V` on the pod)
# numpy 2.1.2                (system site-packages, reused via --system-site-packages)
# matplotlib 3.11.2          (pulled in as a gReLU dependency)
# pandas, anndata, h5py, scipy — present via gReLU, versions not captured
# pyarrow / fastparquet      — ABSENT. This is load-bearing: scripts/93_gate2_scan.py
#                              originally wrote Parquet and failed with
#                              "Unable to find a usable engine", which is why it
#                              now writes CSV.

# ---- platform ----
# OS            Ubuntu 24.04  (inferred: PEP 668 externally-managed-environment
#                              behaviour + Python 3.12 default)
# CUDA          12.8          (from the +cu128 wheel tag)
# GPU           RTX 4090 24 GB for steps 80-83; RTX 3090 24 GB for steps 90-96.
#               Both fit the workload; peak observed GPU memory was 3.82 GB.
# NOT installed flash-attn, conda, Flashzoi — none is needed for this workload.

# ---- install, exactly as run ----
# python3 -m venv --system-site-packages /workspace/venv   # see ENVIRONMENT.md, quirk 1
# /workspace/venv/bin/pip install --upgrade pip
# /workspace/venv/bin/pip install gReLU==1.1.0
# then the NCBI genome staging in scripts/80_setup_pod.sh  # see quirks 2-3
